label: Science Careers
terms_note: AAAS Science jobs; apply via institution.

endpoints.call: keep — assist for apply; the Madgex RSS (text/xml) is a usable public feed
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. Madgex board (AAAS Science); public /jobsrss/ feed, no developer API; robots.txt disallows /apply-profile/. The science.org terms of service answered 403 to the audit host — not read.

search.note: Science Careers job-board RSS (Madgex, RSS 2.0, 20 postings per page). keywords is the board's own search-box parameter (the feed of any search is the search URL under /jobsrss/) and page selects further pages of 20 (checked 2026-09-25: keywords narrows the feed; page=2 returns the next 20, an exhausted page returns an empty channel). location, remote and limit are not sent (location filtering on these boards uses internal location ids). title is 'Employer: Job title' and description begins with the salary line, so company and salary are not split out. id is the posting link.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
